headline: BMO Capital Maintains Market Perform on Builders FirstSource, Lowers Price Target to $85
summary: BMO Capital  analyst Ketan Mamtora   maintains Builders FirstSource (NYSE:BLDR) with a Market Perform and lowers the price target from $93 to $85.
